source:
@@U03434@@
vanish with the first cock’s crow.
Here one day, gone the next.

@@U03436@@
I honor you, venerable head
crowned with dense and lofty oaks,
that not even the moon’s bright glow
can pierce to its midnight depths!
But what’s that faint light I see,
there, in the bushes?
Amazing how things work out!
Its 荷蒙库鲁斯, to be sure!
Where have you been, little friend?

@@U03438@@
Floating around from place to place.
Oh, I want so to find
the finest way of becoming,
and finally shatter in pieces this glass.
But what I’ve seen so far
isn't something I'd like to become a part of.
Promise not to tell,
but I’m on the trail of two philosophers.
I listened in on them,
and they never stopped talking about Nature:
“Nature, Nature!”
I'll want to stick close to them, for sure.
I think they must know the way of
living things, and can show me finally
the wisest course to follow.

@@U03440@@
No, do it yourself,
forge your own path.
Where phantoms are, there are philosophers;
and in the bargain, to ingratiate themselves,
they'll invent a dozen phantoms of their own.
Make no mistakes and you'll never find wisdom!
translation:
@@U03434@@
随着第一声公鸡的啼鸣而消失。
一天在这里，第二天就消失了。

@@U03436@@
我向您致敬，可敬的元首
冠以茂密而高大的橡树，
连月亮的明亮光芒都没有
可以穿透午夜的深处！
但我看到的那微弱的光是什么，
那里，灌木丛里？
事情的进展令人惊奇！
毫无疑问，它是荷蒙库鲁斯！
小朋友你去哪儿了？

@@U03438@@
从一个地方漂到另一个地方。
哦，我想要这样找到
成为最好的方式，
最后把这块玻璃打碎。
但到目前为止我所看到的
我不想成为其中的一部分。
保证不说出去
但我正在追踪两位哲学家。
我偷听了他们的谈话，
他们从未停止谈论自然：
“自然，自然！”
我肯定会想靠近他们。
我想他们一定知道方法
活生生的东西，终于可以告诉我
最明智的做法。

@@U03440@@
不行，自己做吧
开辟自己的道路。
哪里有幽灵，哪里就有哲学家；哪里有幽灵，哪里就有哲学家。
在讨价还价中，为了讨好自己，
他们会发明十几个自己的幻影。
不犯错误，你永远找不到智慧！
